subject: Gold Skulltula #083
text: At Lake Hylia as Adult Link at night, use the Longshot on a tree branch on the island with the large tree to find Gold Skulltula #083 on top of the tree.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #083: [ ] ... How to get: On the island with the large tree, Longshot to a branch on the tree and you'll see this Skulltula on the top of the tree.

subject: Gold Skulltula #084
text: In the Shadow Temple, enter the east door from the large southern room on B3 and defeat all enemies in the spinning scythe room to open the cell holding Gold Skulltula #084.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #084: [ ] ... How to get: In the southern large room in the third basement floor, go through the east door. Inside the invisible spinning scythe statue room, kill all the enemies to open the cell there. Inside the cell is this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #084 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Shadow Temple B4 southwestern room, use the Lens of Truth to find a hidden block and push it under the ceiling spike traps, then Longshot the Gold Skulltula inside the southern cell.

evidence.quote:
In the small jail cell room (in other words, the southwestern-most
 room in B4), find the block inside a wall using the Lens of Truth, and push it
 towards the ceiling spike traps so that the block will...well...block both of
 them from banging down onto the ground. Enter the southern cell to find this
 Skulltula. You'll have to Longshot it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #085
text: In the Shadow Temple, Gold Skulltula #085 is located inside the southern cell of the prison room at the southern end of the fourth basement floor.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #085: [ ] ... How to get: In the prison room at the very south of the fourth basement floor, there's this Skulltula in this room's southern cell.

subject: Gold Skulltula #085 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Shadow Temple, playing the Sun's Song stuns the four ReDeads through the door past the fan corridors so you can Longshot the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door at the end of the fan corridors to see four ReDeads.
 Play the Sun's Song to stun them so that you are free to Longshot the Gold
 Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #086
text: In the Shadow Temple, Gold Skulltula #086 is located behind the giant skull statue in the room north of the large B4 room.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #086: [ ] ... How to get: In the giant skull statue room north of the large room in the fourth floor, this skulltula is behind the skull statue.

subject: Gold Skulltula #086 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Shadow Temple, bombing the dirt piles in the room north of the fan room and south of the boat room reveals a hidden Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the room north of the fan room/south of the boat ride room, bomb
 the dirt piles to find a Gold Skulltula hiding in one of them.

subject: Gold Skulltula #087
text: In the Shadow Temple boat room on B4, push the large block into the indentation, climb the ladder, play the Scarecrow's Song, and Longshot across to reach Gold Skulltula #087.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #087: [ ] ... How to get: In the huge room with a boat on the fourth basement floor, move the large block into the indentation, climb up the ladder from it, turn around, and play the Scarecrow's Song. Longshot across and you'll see this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #087 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Shadow Temple boat ride room, shoot bomb flowers on the west side to drop a bridge, walk halfway across, look down to the right, and Longshot the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the west side of the boat ride room, find some bomb flowers and
 snipe them to create a bridge. Get on the bridge and stop at about halfway.
 Turn around, and look down to your right to find this Skulltula. Longshot it
 and its token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #088
text: In the Shadow Temple, pass through the west door of the B4 boat room, navigate the invisible maze to its west door, and find Gold Skulltula #088 behind the spinning skulls.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #088: [ ] ... How to get: In the west side of the huge boat room on the fourth floor, take west door. Go through this maze of invisible walls next, and enter its west door. Inside, this Skulltula is behind the spinning skulls.

subject: Gold Skulltula #088 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Shadow Temple, use the Lens of Truth and Hover Boots to reach an invisible S-shaped platform in the room before the boss and hit the Gold Skulltula with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
In the room just before the boss is a Gold Skulltula crawling
 around on an invisible platform shaped a bit like an S. Get over there with
 the help of the Lens of Truth and Hover Boots, and find a spot where you can
 hit it with the Longshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #089
text: At Gerudo Fortress, Gold Skulltula #089 is crawling on the east cliff side at the very top of the fortress and requires the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #089: [ ] ... How to get: Up at the very top of the fortress, this Skulltula is crawling around on the east cliff side.

subject: Gold Skulltula #090
text: In the Gerudo Fortress Horseback Archery area, Gold Skulltula #090 is located high on the wall on the far left.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #090: [ ] ... How to get: In the Horseback Archery area, head to the far left of this area to find this Skulltula high on the wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula #091
text: In Haunted Wasteland, follow the flag markers past the River of Sand to the ghost guide shrine, where Gold Skulltula #091 is located inside.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #091: [ ] ... How to get: Follow the flag markers after the River of Sand to find a shrine where you'll meet the ghost guide. Head inside to find this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #092
text: At Desert Colossus at night, Gold Skulltula #092 is on a palm tree near the Fairy Fountain grove.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #092: [ ] ... How to get: At night, head towards the Fairy Fountain. The Gold Skulltula is on a palm tree nearby.

subject: Gold Skulltula #093
text: At Desert Colossus as Young Link, drop bugs from a bottle into the soft dirt patch to make Gold Skulltula #093 emerge.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #093: [ ] ... How to get: Warp to the Collosus as Young Link, and drop some bugs from a bottle onto the plot of dirt nearby to make this Skulltula pop out.

subject: Gold Skulltula #094
text: In the Spirit Temple 1F circular rooms left of the entrance, Gold Skulltula #094 is on the gate facing the gap in the right-hand room.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #094: [ ] ... How to get: In the circular series of rooms left of the entrance in the first floor, the right room has a gap with a gate on the other side. This Skulltula is on the gate facing the gap.

subject: Gold Skulltula #094 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Spirit Temple, push or pull the sunface block south of the crystal switch into sunlight to spawn an ice block above, then Longshot up and grab the Gold Skulltula on the other ice block.

evidence.quote:
Push/pull the sunface block south of the crystal switch to the
 sunlight to make an ice block appear above. Longshot up there, then Longshot
 the Gold Skulltula on the other ice block.

subject: Gold Skulltula #095
text: In the Spirit Temple 1F circular rooms, climb the central rock face to the top and turn around to find Gold Skulltula #095 on the opposite wall.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #095: [ ] ... How to get: In the center of the circular series of rooms left of the entrance in the first floor is a sheer rock face leading to the second floor. Climb to the top and turn around to find this Skulltula on the wall opposite the climbable wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula #095 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Spirit Temple, pass east of the entrance past the water jet and enter the west door to find a Gold Skulltula on the ceiling.

evidence.quote:
East of the entrance room, past that water jet, enter the west 
 door. Inside, look up at the ceiling to spot this Gold Skulltula. Longshot it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #096
text: In the Spirit Temple en route to the Iron Knuckle miniboss, Gold Skulltula #096 is high on the wall above the door by the staircase leading to the battle.

evidence.quote: Gold Skulltula #096: [ ] ... How to get: While heading to the Iron Knuckle miniboss, this Gold Skulltula is high up on the wall of the door at the staircase leading to the battle.

subject: Gold Skulltula #096 (Master Quest)
text: In Master Quest Spirit Temple northeast 1F room, play Song of Time, Epona's Song, Sun's Song, Song of Storms, and Zelda's Lullaby in sequence inside successive alcoves to unlock the door to the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Requirements: Song of Time, Epona's Song, Sun's Song, Song of Storms, Zelda's
 Lullaby, Longshot, Small Key, Megaton Hammer...Now, in this room, each song you
 play in each alcove will open up the next, and the order of songs is actually
 shown in the requirements. So play one song inside an alcove, get into the
 next, play the next song, etc... Afterwards, the door to the Gold Skulltula
 will open.
